title: Syrians grow frustrated as soaring living costs threaten recovery
summary:
People burned tyres, blocked roads and chanted slogans, angry at the government's decision to raise fuel prices again.
It was the largest show of discontent yet since President Ahmed al-Sharaa came to power two years ago.

title: Alphabet Is in Talks to Join Trump’s Golden Dome Defense Program
summary:
(Bloomberg) -- Alphabet Inc.'s Google is in talks with the US Defense Department to work on a new data security effort underpinning the $185 billion Golden Dome missile defense program, according to people familiar with the matter.
The talks have focused on Google's data storage, networking and cybersecurity capabilities, one of the people said.
Golden Dome is President Donald Trump's marquee defense program to build a layer of defense systems from ground to space that will protect the US from foreign attack.
The effort would mark Google's first publicly known involvement in the Golden Dome program and another sign of how the search engine giant is continuing to lean into national security and defense work.
Both the Pentagon's separate Golden Dome initiatives to pioneer space-based missile interceptors and its command-and-control consortium rely on numerous companies from startups to established primes, unlike past defense programs that have been more typically anchored by a single, large contractor.

title: Serbia: Student-backed election winners demand sweeping resignations
summary:
Serbia's victorious student-led movement has called for top figures in the police, intelligence and judiciary to stand down, days after ousting ex-president Aleksandar Vučić's party from power.
Standing in Pioneers' Park opposite parliament, newly elected MPs on the Student List demanded the immediate dismissal of all police officers who had broken the law, singling out the heads of the police, the BIA security agency and anti-terror unit.
But the handover of power will take weeks, and the students' movement is concerned that evidence of possible wrongdoing could be destroyed in that time.
Just a few days ago, the park they were standing in on Thursday was a tent camp, filled with Vučić loyalists outside his office.
Within hours of him admitting defeat on Sunday night, the camp was dismantled, and a team of volunteers moved in on Monday morning to clean up the mess.

title: Could Trump’s Foreign Policy Cost the GOP the Midterms?
summary:
At first sight this appears to support the conventional wisdom that US voters generally don’t care about foreign policy.
But traditional understandings of the electoral importance of foreign policy often reflect misunderstandings about the way in which voters assess candidates for office.
One reason a president’s foreign policy might lose him or his party votes is when their administration’s choices directly affect the daily lives of voters.
But what these polls miss is the degree to which voters today are blaming the administration’s foreign policy choices for the poor state of the economy.

title: Canada's new national security strategy will shield economy, modernize military
summary:
Defending the economy and preparing for the possibility of war in a more unstable world top the list of priorities in Canada's new national security strategy.
The Trump administration's own National Security Strategy, released almost a year ago, seeks to make the U.S. the pre-eminent power in the Western Hemisphere.
